newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Energy to build Philippine copper foil plant.
newsitem.headline: Japan Energy to build Philippine copper foil plant.

text.p: Japan Energy Corp and its units will build a copper foil plant in the Philippines by early 1998, eyeing growing demand for the product in Southeast Asia, a company spokeswoman said on Thursday.

The copper foil plant, GNF (Philippines) Inc, will be located near Manila and is to be completed by early 1998. It will produce 360 tonnes of copper foil a month, the spokeswoman said. The plant will be capitalised at $20 million.
The Japan Energy Corp units involved in the venture are Nikko Gould Foil Co Ltd of Japan and Gould Electronics Inc of the United States, she said.
Copper foil demand is rising in Southeast Asia as it is a key component used in the manufacture of computers and mobile phones.
"One reason we chose the Philippines is that English is widely used there," the Japan Energy Corp spokeswoman said.
She did not say when actual production would start at the plant.
